faq_heading: Homes near Clearbrook Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Clearbrook Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Abbotsford School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Clearbrook Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Clearbrook Elementary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Clearbrook Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 27 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $957,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Clearbrook Elementary?
faq.a: Near Clearbrook Elementary (1 km), homes took a median 18 days to sell and closed at 96.4% of the list price, with 4% over asking, across 27 sales.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Clearbrook Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are W J Mouat Secondary (1.0 km south), Colleen And Gordie Howe Middle School (1.0 km south) and Mennonite Educational Institute (1.2 km north-west).

Clearbrook Elementary is an elementary school in Abbotsford (Abbotsford School District), at 3614 Clearbrook Rd. It teaches grades K to 5. Programs listed: Early French Immersion.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Clearbrook Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Clearbrook Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Clearbrook Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Clearbrook Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 27 homes sold within 1 km of Clearbrook Elementary: 26 houses. The largest group was houses, at a median of $957,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Clearbrook Elementary

18 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Clearbrook Elementary in a straight line (9 elementary, 3 secondary, 3 middle, 3 other; 4 independent). The closest is W J Mouat Secondary, 1.0 km away, and the farthest on this list is Abbotsford Traditional School, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Dr Roberta Bondar Elementary (1.3 km); the nearest independent school is Mennonite Educational Institute (1.2 km). Other elementary schools close by: Dr Roberta Bondar Elementary (1.3 km east), Harry Sayers Elementary (1.5 km west), John Maclure Community School (1.8 km south-east), Ten Broeck Elementary (2.1 km south), Blue Jay Elementary (2.5 km south-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-5) is Dr Roberta Bondar Elementary, 1.3 km east of Clearbrook Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Clearbrook Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Abbotsford school finder. A home a few blocks from Clearbrook Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Go past Clearbrook Elementary on a school morning and again mid-afternoon to see the traffic, parking and noise before you offer.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Clearbrook Elementary was $957,500, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Dr Roberta Bondar Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 1.3 km east of Clearbrook Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
